mapper.insert: insert into product_sku (dish_id, spec_name, spec_value, price, stock, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{dishId}, #{specName}, #{specValue}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select * from product_sku where dish_id = #{dishId} and spec_value = #{specValue} and status = 1 limit 1
select * from product_sku where dish_id = #{dishId} order by id

select p.id as skuId, p.dish_id as dishId, d.name as productName, d.image, p.spec_name as specName, p.spec_value as specValue, p.price, p.stock from product_sku p join dish d on d.id = p.dish_id where p.status = 1 and d.status = 1
and (d.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.spec_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.spec_value like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by d.name, p.id limit 30
mapper.update: update product_sku set stock = stock - #{quantity} where id = #{skuId} and status = 1 and stock >= #{quantity}
update product_sku set stock = stock + #{quantity}, update_time = now() where id = #{skuId}
